text:
By Dan Harralson ,
1 days ago Nov. 26, 2025; Las Vegas, NV, USA; Tennessee Volunteers forward Jaylen Carey (23) dunks while defended by Kansas Jayhawks guard Melvin Council Jr. (14) in the first half in the 2025 Players Era Festival third place game at MGM Grand Garden Arena. By Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Tennessee (9-3) basketball last played on Dec. 21. The Vols defeated Gardner-Webb, 94-52, at Food City Center and are ranked No. 20 in the USA TODAY Sports Coaches Poll .
Tennessee has recorded wins over Mercer, Northern Kentucky, North Florida, Rice, Tennessee State, Rutgers, Houston, Louisville and Gardner-Webb since tipping off its 2025-26 regular season on Nov. 3. The Vols have suffered losses to Kansas, Syracuse and Illinois.
Tennessee will next play again on Tuesday. The Vols will host South Carolina State at Food City Center. Tipoff is slated for 8 p.m. EST.
The Vols will open Southeastern Conference play against Arkansas on Jan. 3, 2026. Tipoff between Tennessee and the Razorbacks is scheduled for 3 p.m. EST at Bud Walton Arena in Fayetteville, Arkansas (ESPN2).
Tennessee’s home opener in SEC play will take place against Texas on Jan. 6, 2026. The league matchup is slated for 9 p.m. EST and will be televised ESPN2.
Below is how to watch information for the Tennessee-South Carolina State basketball game on Tuesday.
